Change c0413. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. IV; 1831 Ch. XXI.

Context before (unchanged): "Alas! yes, my father," replied I; "some destiny of the most horrible kind hangs over me, and I must live to fulfil it, or surely I should have died on the coffin of Henry."

1818 text: We were not allowed to converse for any length of time, for the precarious state of my health rendered every precaution necessary that could insure tranquillity.

1831 text: We were not allowed to converse for any length of time, for the precarious state of my health rendered every precaution necessary that could ensure tranquillity.

Diff: We were not allowed to converse for any length of time, for the precarious state of my health rendered every precaution necessary that could [-insure-] {+ensure+} tranquillity.

Context after (unchanged): Mr. Kirwin came in, and insisted that my strength should not be exhausted by too much exertion.

result.rationale: "insure" becomes "ensure" in the phrase "could ensure tranquillity". This is a modernized or standardized orthographic variant with the same meaning and no interpretive consequence.
